theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Technology (+1.12%) and Communication Svcs (+0.94%) led the market today, while Materials (-2.39%) and Consumer Staples (-2.32%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +0.37% versus -1.13% for defensives and -0.74% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.80% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.39%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.25%. The VIX fell 1.61% to 20.83, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.07% to $3,935.50, crude oil was little changed at $96.59, and bitcoin slipped 0.30% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
